📝 Summary
## Summary by CodeRabbit * **New Features** * RTF import and export support more language settings, fields, notes, list types, column breaks, bookmarks, and table widths. Images in table cells appear as labeled placeholders. * EPUB exports preserve custom paragraph and character styles and list markers, infer text direction when unspecified, and include usable unreferenced notes with a warning. * **Improvements** * EPUB exports handle page-number fields and references with warnings when values or targets are unavailable, and omit hidden content. * PDF accessibility tagging improves reading order across repeated copies and supports nested lists and merged table cells with row and column spans. Special characters in image descriptions are better preserved. Wave 25 changes RTF import and export, EPUB export, and tagged PDF output. It adds format-specific QA suites and fixtures, and updates specifications, documentation, and delivery records.
